21:1: Their reckoning has approached for mankind, and they are turning away in heedlessness.
21:2: Every new remembrance that comes to them from their Rabb, they only listen to it while their hearts are amused.
21:3: Their hearts are heedless, and those who did wrong concealed the secret: "Is this anything other than a human being like you? Are you coming to sorcery while you see?"
21:4: He said: "My Rabb knows what is spoken in the heaven and the earth, and He is the All-Hearing, the All-Knowing."
21:5: Rather, they said: "Muddled dreams." Rather, he invented it. Rather, he is a poet. So let him bring us a sign, just as the former ones were sent.
21:6: No town that We destroyed before them had believed; will these then believe?
21:7: And before you We did not send messengers except men to whom We revealed. Ask the people of the remembrance if you do not know.
21:8: We did not make them bodies that do not eat food, and they were not immortals.
21:9: Then We fulfilled the promise to them, so We saved them and whom We willed, and We destroyed the transgressors.
21:10: By oath, We have sent down to you a book in which is your remembrance; will you not still reason?
21:11: And how many a town that was unjust did We crush, and after it We produced another people.
21:12: When they perceived Our raid, they were immediately fleeing from it.
21:13: Do not run, return to that in which you were pampered and to your dwellings, that you may perhaps be questioned.
21:14: They said: "Woe to us, indeed we were wrongdoers."
21:15: This call of theirs did not cease until We made them reaped and extinguished.
21:16: And We did not create the heaven and the earth and what is between them as players.
21:17: If We had intended to take an amusement, We would have taken it from Our own presence, if We were to do so.
21:18: Rather, We hurl the truth against falsehood, so it crushes its brain, and behold, it perishes. And woe to you for what you describe.
21:19: Whoever is in the heavens and the earth belongs to Him. Those who are in His presence do not show arrogance against worshipping Him, nor do they tire.
21:20: They glorify night and day, they do not flag.
21:21: Or have they taken gods from the earth who raise the dead?
21:22: If there had been in the two of them gods besides Allah, both of them would surely have been ruined. Allah, the Rabb of the Throne, is exalted above what they describe.
21:23: He is not questioned about what He does, but they will be questioned.
21:24: Or have they taken gods besides Him? Say: "Bring your proof. This is the remembrance of those with me and the remembrance of those before me." Nay, most of them do not know the truth, so they turn away.
21:25: And We did not send any messenger before you without revealing to him: 'There is no god except Me, so worship Me.'
21:26: And they said: "The Rahman has taken a child." He is exalted. Rather, they are honored servants.
21:27: They do not precede Him in speech, and they act by His command.
21:28: He knows what is before them and what is behind them, and they do not intercede except for whom He is pleased with, and they tremble from fear of Him.
21:29: And whoever among them says, 'I am a god besides Him,' that one We penalize with Hell. Thus We penalize the wrongdoers.
21:30: Have not those who disbelieve seen that the heavens and the earth were joined together and We separated them, and We made from water every living thing; will they then not believe?
21:31: And We placed in the earth mountains lest it should shake them, and We placed in it broad paths that perhaps they may find the right way.
21:32: And We made the sky a protected roof, and they turn away from its signs.
21:33: And it is He who created the night and the day and the sun and the moon; all are floating in an orbit.
21:34: We did not grant immortality to any human being before you; so if you die, are they to remain immortal?
21:35: Every soul will taste death, and We test you with evil and with good as a trial, and to Us you will be returned.
21:36: And when those who disbelieve see you, they take you only in mockery: "Is this the one who mentions your gods?" they say. Whereas they are the ones who disbelieve in the remembrance of the Rahman.
21:37: Man was created from haste. I will show you My signs, so do not ask Me to hasten.
21:38: And they say: "When is this promise, if you are truthful?"
21:39: If only those who disbelieve knew the time when the fire cannot be warded off from their faces and from their backs, and they will not be helped.
21:40: Rather, it comes to them suddenly, stupefying them; so they cannot turn it back, nor will they be granted respite.
21:41: And by oath, messengers before you were indeed mocked, so that which they mocked enveloped those who mocked.
21:42: Say: "Who protects you by night and day from the Rahman?" Nay, they are those who turn away from the remembrance of their Rabb.
21:43: Or do they have gods besides Us who can defend them? They are not able to help themselves, nor will they have companions from Us.
21:44: Rather, We gave enjoyment to these and their fathers until their lives grew long. Do they not see that We come to the land, reducing it from its edges? Is it then they who will prevail?
21:45: Say: "I only warn you with revelation, and the deaf do not hear the call when they are warned."
21:46: And if a breath of the punishment of your Rabb should touch them, they will surely say: "Woe to us, indeed we were wrongdoers."
21:47: And We set up the scales of justice for the Day of Resurrection. No soul is wronged in anything. Even if it were the weight of a mustard seed, We bring it.
21:48: And by oath, We gave Moses and Aaron the furqan and the light and the remembrance for the muttaqeen.
21:49: Those who fear their Rabb in the unseen, and they are trembling from the Hour of Resurrection.
21:50: And this is a blessed remembrance that We have sent down. Are you then denying it?
21:51: By oath, We had given Abraham his right guidance before, and We were knowing of him.
21:52: When he said to his father and his people: "What are these statues that you stand before and worship?"
21:53: They said: "We found our fathers worshippers of them."
21:54: He said: "By oath, you and your fathers were in clear error."
21:55: They said: "Have you brought us the truth, or are you of those who play?"
21:56: He said: "Rather, your Rabb is the Rabb of the heavens and the earth, who created them. And I am of those who bear witness to this."
21:57: By Allah, I will surely devise a plot against your idols after you turn your backs.
21:58: So he smashed them into pieces, except for a large one of them, so that they might perhaps return to it.
21:59: They said: "Who did this to our gods? Indeed, he is surely of the wrongdoers."
21:60: They said: "We heard a young man mention them; he is called Abraham."
21:61: They said: "Then bring him before the eyes of the people so that they may bear witness."
21:62: They said: "Did you do this to our gods, O Abraham?"
21:63: He said: "Rather, this big one of them did it. Ask them, if they can speak."
21:64: Thereupon they turned to themselves and said: "Indeed, you are the wrongdoers."
21:65: Then they were turned back upon their heads: By oath, you know that these do not speak.
21:66: He said: "Do you then worship besides Allah things that do not benefit you at all and do not harm you?"
21:67: Fie upon you and upon what you worship besides Allah; will you still not use reason?
21:68: They said: "If you are to do (so), burn him and help your gods."
21:69: We said: "O fire, be coolness and peace for Abraham."
21:70: They intended a plot against him, but We made them the greatest losers.
21:71: And We saved him and Lot, delivering them to the land which We blessed for the worlds.
21:72: And We bestowed upon him Isaac and Jacob as an addition, and We made each of them righteous.
21:73: And We made them leaders guiding by Our command, and We revealed to them the doing of good deeds, the establishing of salah, and the giving of zakat. And they were worshippers of Us.
21:74: And to Lot We gave judgment and knowledge, and We saved him from the town that was doing foul deeds. Indeed, they were an evil people, defiantly disobedient.
21:75: And We admitted him into Our mercy. Indeed, he was of the righteous.
21:76: And Noah, when he called out previously, We responded to him. We saved him and his family from the great distress.
21:77: And We helped him against the people who denied Our verses. Indeed, they were an evil people, so We drowned them all.
21:78: And David and Solomon, when they were judging concerning the field, when the people's sheep had grazed in it, and We were witnesses to their judgment.
21:79: So We made Solomon understand it, and to each We gave judgment and knowledge, and We subjected the mountains and the birds along with David, they glorify (Us), and We were the doers.
21:80: And We taught him the making of garments of armor for you to protect you from your battle; so are you grateful?
21:81: And for Solomon, (We subjected) the violent wind, flowing by his command toward the land which We blessed, and We are Knowers of all things.
21:82: And of the devils were those who dived for him and did deeds other than that, and We were guardians over them.
21:83: And Job, when he called out to his Rabb: "Adversity has touched me, and You are the most merciful of the merciful," he said.
21:84: So We responded to him and removed the harm that was on him, and We gave him his family and the like of them with them as a mercy from Us and a reminder for the worshippers.
21:85: And remember Ishmael, Idris, and Dhul-Kifl; all were of the patient.
21:86: And We admitted them into Our mercy. Indeed, they were of the righteous.
21:87: And remember Dhun-Nun, when he went off in anger and thought that We would never constrict him, then he called out in the darknesses: 'There is no god except You; You are free from imperfections; indeed, I have been of the wrongdoers.'
21:88: So We responded to him and saved him from grief, and thus We save the believers.
21:89: And remember Zechariah, when he called out to his Rabb: "My Rabb, do not leave me alone; and You are the best of inheritors," he had said.
21:90: So We responded to him and bestowed Yahya upon him, and We cured his wife for him. Indeed, they used to hasten in good deeds and call upon Us in longing and fear, and they were humble before Us.
21:91: And remember the woman who guarded her chastity; We breathed into her from Our spirit and made her and her son a sign for the worlds.
21:92: Indeed, this nation of yours is a single nation, and I am your Rabb, so worship Me.
21:93: They tore their affair apart among themselves; all of them will return to Us.
21:94: Whoever does righteous deeds while he is a believer, there is no denial for his effort, and indeed, We are recorders of it.
21:95: And it is forbidden for the people of a town which We have destroyed that they return.
21:96: Until when Gog and Magog are let loose, and they swarm from every mound.
21:97: And the true promise has approached, and thereupon the eyes of those who disbelieved stare in horror: 'Woe to us! We were in heedlessness of this; rather, we were wrongdoers,' they say.
21:98: Indeed, you and what you worship besides Allah are firewood of Hell; you will enter it.
21:99: If these had been gods, they would not have entered it, and each of them will abide in it eternally.
21:100: For them therein is groaning, and they do not hear therein.
21:101: Indeed, those for whom good has preceded from Us, it is they who will be kept far removed from it.
21:102: They will not hear its rustle, and they will abide eternally in what their souls desire.
21:103: The greatest terror will not grieve them, and the angels will meet them: 'This is your day which you were promised,' they say.
21:104: That Day We will roll up the heaven like the rolling up of the scroll for the writings. As We began the first creation, We will repeat it. A promise upon Us; indeed, We will do (it).
21:105: By oath, We wrote in the Psalms after the Remembrance that the earth shall be inherited by My righteous servants.
21:106: Indeed, in this is a message for a people who worship.
21:107: And We sent you only as a mercy to the worlds.
21:108: Say: 'It is only revealed to me that your god is one god. So are you Muslims?'
21:109: If they turn away, then say: 'I have announced to you equally. And I do not know whether what you are promised is near or far.'
21:110: Indeed, He knows what is declared of speech, and He knows what you conceal.
21:111: And I do not know; perhaps it is a trial for you and an enjoyment for a time.
21:112: He said: 'My Rabb, judge with truth. Our Rabb is al-Rahman, and the One whose help is sought against what you describe.'
